newsitem.title: JAPAN: Green Cross in talks with BMS on AIDS drug sales.
newsitem.headline: Green Cross in talks with BMS on AIDS drug sales.

text.p: Green Cross Corp said on Thursday that it was negotiating with Bristol-Myers Squibb Co (BMS) regarding sales of BMS's AIDS drug d4T.
A Green Cross spokesman added that the talks had not reached any conclusions yet.
"We are negotiating over sales of d4T but nothing has yet been decided," the company spokesman said.
The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday that the two companies had already agreed on joint sales of the drug in Japan.
It said the two firms were discussing joint sales of ddI, another BMS AIDS drug which BMS already sells in Japan.
